sections.content: Pseudo-classes style states (:hover, :focus, :active, :first-child, :nth-child()) and pseudo-elements style parts (::before, ::after, ::placeholder).
:hover only works on devices with hover — pair with @media (hover:hover) for touch safety. ::before/::after inject decorative content without HTML.
Key points: :focus-visible shows keyboard focus only, ::selection styles highlighted text, and :nth-child formulas (2n = every other) are powerful.
